about: Apotex Health Corp. operates as a pharmaceutical manufacturing company in Canada, the United States, Mexico, and India. The company develops, manufactures, and distributes a portfolio of prescription and generic pharmaceuticals, oncology biosimilar pharmaceuticals, branded specialty pharmaceuticals, and branded consumer health and wellness products. Apotex Health Corp. has a strategic partnership with Halo Pharmaceutical, Inc. The company was formerly known as Artemis Parent, Inc. and changed its name to Apotex Health Corp. in May 2026. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Apotex Health Corp. operates as a subsidiary of SK Artemis Holdings, II, LLC.
